## Summary

Describe the user-visible or maintenance outcome and the reason for the change.

## Verification

- [ ] `make verify`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] Added or updated tests for behavior changes, or explained why none are needed
- [ ] Updated user or maintainer documentation when behavior or release steps changed

## Risk and compatibility

Note archive compatibility, security boundaries, localization, accessibility, performance, or release implications. Write “None” when no item applies.

## Artifact checks (when packaging changes)

- [ ] `make example`
- [ ] `make build`
- [ ] `make app`
- [ ] `make verify-artifacts`
- [ ] Development, signed-but-not-notarized, and notarized artifacts are labeled accurately
